text_copy.text:
2-minute read

Acute Care's Training and Education page offers healthcare professionals a robust collection of learning resources designed to enhance clinical education and help drive improve patient outcomes. The page provides on-demand webinars, online and in-person training opportunities and additional tools created specifically for those in clinical fields. This page is a valuable resource for professionals seeking to stay informed about the latest developments in healthcare.

The featured webinars cover a variety of critical topics. Strategies for Reducing Falls in the ED addresses the rising concern of patient falls in emergency departments, offering insights on risk factors, interventions and evidence-based practices. Lightening the Load: Unpacking Cognitive Overload explores the effects of cognitive overload on clinical teams, focusing on system-wide solutions and the role of technology in alleviating the burden on healthcare professionals. Additionally, The Science Behind Support Surfaces webinar, presented in partnership with Becker's Healthcare, discusses the clinical benefits of various support surface technologies in the prevention and treatment of pressure injuries.

The page also highlights a variety of outcome stories, case studies and whitepapers that offer real-world applications of the training material. These resources provide insights into best practices and demonstrate how clinical education can help lead to better patient outcomes. Additionally, the page showcases upcoming events, keeping healthcare professionals updated on new opportunities for professional growth.
